-- Alle aktiven Salons abfragen
SELECT id AS salon_id, name AS salon_name, owner_name, phone AS owner_phone
FROM salons
WHERE is_active = true;

-- KPIs für heute berechnen
WITH today_bookings AS (
  SELECT * FROM bookings
  WHERE salon_id = '{{ $json.salon_id }}'
    AND start_time::date = CURRENT_DATE
),
today_revenue AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
  FROM today_bookings
  WHERE status = 'completed' AND payment_status = 'paid'
),
today_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_bookings,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') AS completed,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'no_show') AS no_shows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled
  FROM today_bookings
),
new_clients AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM clients
  WHERE salon_id = '{{ $json.salon_id }}'
    AND created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE
),
avg_rating AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) AS avg_rating
  FROM today_bookings
  WHERE rating IS NOT NULL
),
occupancy AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT st.id) > 0 THEN
      ROUND(
        (COUNT(DISTINCT b.id)::DECIMAL / (COUNT(DISTINCT st.id) * 16)) * 100,
        1
      )
    ELSE 0 END AS occupancy_pct
  FROM staff st
  LEFT JOIN today_bookings b ON b.staff_id = st.id AND b.status IN ('confirmed','completed')
  WHERE st.salon_id = '{{ $json.salon_id }}' AND st.is_active = true
)
SELECT
  tr.revenue_cents,
  tc.total_bookings AS booking_count,
  tc.completed AS completed_count,
  nc.count AS new_clients,
  tc.no_shows AS no_show_count,
  tc.cancelled AS cancellation_count,
  ar.avg_rating,
  o.occupancy_pct
FROM today_revenue tr, today_counts tc, new_clients nc, avg_rating ar, occupancy o;

-- KPI Snapshot speichern
INSERT INTO kpi_snapshots (
  salon_id, date, revenue_cents, booking_count, completed_count,
  new_clients, no_show_count, cancellation_count, avg_rating, occupancy_pct
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('DB: Aktive Salons').item.json.salon_id }}',
  CURRENT_DATE,
  {{ $json.revenue_cents || 0 }},
  {{ $json.booking_count || 0 }},
  {{ $json.completed_count || 0 }},
  {{ $json.new_clients || 0 }},
  {{ $json.no_show_count || 0 }},
  {{ $json.cancellation_count || 0 }},
  {{ $json.avg_rating || 0 }},
  {{ $json.occupancy_pct || 0 }}
)
ON CONFLICT (salon_id, date) DO UPDATE SET
  revenue_cents = EXCLUDED.revenue_cents,
  booking_count = EXCLUDED.booking_count,
  completed_count = EXCLUDED.completed_count,
  new_clients = EXCLUDED.new_clients,
  no_show_count = EXCLUDED.no_show_count,
  cancellation_count = EXCLUDED.cancellation_count,
  avg_rating = EXCLUDED.avg_rating,
  occupancy_pct = EXCLUDED.occupancy_pct;
